Isha Verma: Hi all — Isha here (ML infra). First day! PR smoke fails because the job flips a staging flag but I don’t have Console access. Who owns staging flag role mappings?
Rory Blake: Welcome Isha! :wave: Eng-infra handles that. For staging flips you either use `ff-test/*` or request a service account scoped to `console.flags.write`.
Isha Verma: Is there a short request flow I can use? Prefer not to block PRs.
infra-bot: Please submit an access request at https://redwood.internal/access-requests. Choose "Console service account (staging)" and include manager approval. Staging CI tokens are typically 30d.
Anita Singh: If it’s ephemeral for PR smoke, try moving the flag to `ff-test/` — those are auto-scoped and don’t need admin role.
Isha Verma: The job flips `experiments/model-canary`. I can change it to `ff-test/model-canary` — any downside?
Rory Blake: `ff-test/*` flags are cleared periodically, so don’t use them for multi-job state. For PR smoke they’re perfect. If you still need persistent state, submit the form and ping me here.
Isha Verma: OK switching to `ff-test/model-canary` now. If I still need SA I’ll open the request and include job name + exact flag keys. Thanks!
Priya Nair: Quick tip — if your GHA runs on forks, secrets aren’t available; gate the flag-flip step to branches on the main repo.
Isha Verma: Good call, will gate it. Appreciate the fast help!
